answer: Every claim climbs the comet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the hollow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the jetty of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
